The '''Garis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garis]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is not be confused with the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]].
